t: This is a bust of William Booth, made by the sculptor George Edward Wade. Booth was an English Methodist preacher who, with his wife Catherine, founded the Salvation Army. He became its first General and held that role from 1878 until 1912. The movement began in London in 1865 and has since spread to many parts of the world, and it is one of the largest distributors of humanitarian aid. Wade was a largely self-taught British sculptor, best remembered for his statues of royalty and politicians.
